assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) was ordered
The service was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes
The service was medically necessary to address the patient's recurrent dizziness and giddiness
The clinical indication note documents the symptoms
The claim was denied under Reason Code CO-197
The denial was for lack of precertification
The prior authorization requirement does not override the demonstrated medical necessity of the service
